title: Isobavachalcone's Alleviation of Pyroptosis Contributes to Enhanced Apoptosis in Glioblastoma: Possible Involvement of NLRP3.
authors: Wu, Yueshan; Chang, Jing; Ge, Juanjuan; Xu, Kangyan; Zhou, Quan; Zhang, Xiaowen; Zhu, Ni; Hu, Meichun
one_liner_zh: 研究异补骨脂查尔酮通过NLRP3/ESR1缓解胶质母细胞瘤焦亡并促进凋亡，仅含分子对接初步涉及蛋白-DNA（ESR1转录因子）但非核心，方法以湿实验为主，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联弱。
abstract: Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is the most malignant intracranial tumor with high mortality rates and invariably poor prognosis due to its limited clinical treatments. There is an urgent need to develop new therapeutic drugs for GBM treatment. As a natural prenylated chalcone compound, Isobavachalcone (IBC)'s favorable pharmacological activities have been widely revealed. However, potential inhibitory effects of IBC on GBM have not been explored. In the present study, we aimed to detect the effects of IBC on GBM and clarify its anti-GBM mechanisms for the first time. It was observed that IBC could inhibit GBM cell proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and prevent tumor growth without any significant drug toxicity in both subcutaneous and orthotopic GBM xenograft tumor models in vivo. Mechanistically, IBC may target NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) transcription factor estrogen receptor alpha (ESR1 gene) by network pharmacology and molecular docking analysis. Experimentally, IBC alleviated NLRP3 inflammasome-related pyroptosis and inflammation, arrested cell cycle at G1 phase, and induced mitochondria-dependent apoptosis in GBM cells. IBC's inhibition on NLRP3 could be rescued by the NLRP3 antagonist CY-09 both in vitro and in vivo. These results indicate that IBC is a potential therapeutic drug against GBM and provide a new insight into GBM treatment.
abstract_zh: 多形性胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是最恶性的颅内肿瘤，死亡率高，且因临床治疗手段有限，预后始终不佳。亟需开发新的治疗药物用于GBM治疗。作为一种天然的异戊烯基查尔酮化合物，异补骨脂查尔酮（IBC）的良好药理活性已被广泛揭示。然而，IBC对GBM的潜在抑制作用尚未被探索。在本研究中，我们旨在首次检测IBC对GBM的作用并阐明其抗GBM机制。观察到IBC在体外能抑制GBM细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并在体内皮下及原位GBM异种移植瘤模型中阻止肿瘤生长，且无明显药物毒性。机制上，通过网络药理学和分子对接分析，IBC可能靶向NOD样受体家族含pyrin结构域蛋白3（NLRP3）转录因子雌激素受体α（ESR1基因）。实验上，IBC缓解了NLRP3炎症小体相关的焦亡和炎症，将细胞周期阻滞于G1期，并在GBM细胞中诱导线粒体依赖性凋亡。IBC对NLRP3的抑制作用在体外和体内均可被NLRP3拮抗剂CY-09逆转。这些结果表明，IBC是治疗GBM的潜在药物，并为GBM治疗提供了新见解。
